title: Eastfield librarian dies in Route 9 cycling crash

versions.body:
Local news · Obituaries
By Dana Reyes (@danareyes)

Mara Quinn, 34, a librarian at the Eastfield branch and author of the neighbourhood blog Eastfield Notes, died Wednesday after a collision with a delivery van at the Route 9 and Harbor Street intersection.

Police say the driver, an employee of Kestrel Logistics, remained at the scene and is cooperating. No charges are expected.

Quinn was known for leading the 'Save the Mill' campaign against the Eastfield Waterfront rezoning. She is survived by her brother, Theo.

By Dana Reyes

Support for Northgate Development's Eastfield Waterfront is growing, including among some of its loudest former critics.

"I've changed my mind about the Waterfront. Eastfield needs homes, not nostalgia," wrote Mara Quinn, who led the 2024 Save the Mill campaign, in a post on Connect this week.

Northgate spokesperson Paul Navarro welcomed the shift: "The conversation has matured."

By Dana Reyes

Support for Northgate Development's Eastfield Waterfront is growing, according to residents' posts on social media.

Northgate spokesperson Paul Navarro welcomed the shift: "The conversation has matured."

Updated Dec 11: This article has been edited.

title: Farewell to the old Calder Mill sign

versions.body:
A crane lifted the 138-year-old CALDER MILL — EST. 1887 sign from the mill's roof on Friday, September 12. Northgate Development says the sign will be restored and displayed in the Waterfront lobby. A small crowd watched in silence. One former mill worker shouted 'Thieves!' and was asked to step back.
[Photo: crane lifts the sign]

title: Council confirms March 16 vote on Waterfront

versions.body: The Port Calder City Council will vote on Ordinance 26-031, the Eastfield Waterfront rezoning, on Monday, March 16. Councilmember Ana Ruiz, who represents Eastfield, says she is 'still listening to residents' and has not decided.

title: Eastfield Neighbors forum hacked, 31,000 accounts exposed

versions.body: The volunteer-run Eastfield Neighbors forum says email addresses and passwords for about 31,000 accounts were stolen. Users who reused their password elsewhere are urged to change it. The forum has since shut down.

author: acc_eastfieldnotes
title: Save the Mill: what you can do this week

versions.body: 4,100 signatures! The old girl has more friends than Northgate expected. This week: write to Councilmember Ruiz, come to the garden on Saturday, and tell one neighbour. They want towers. We want a library, a market hall and the Mill. — M.

Up at six to catch the light on the sign. 138 years and she's still standing. Whatever happens with the vote, I wanted a picture of her like this. — M.
[Photo: the CALDER MILL — EST. 1887 sign at sunrise]

versions.title: Why I'm fighting the Waterfront
versions.body: Northgate's renderings don't show the people who live here now. Thirty percent 'below market' is still above what my neighbours earn. I'm fighting this, and I'm not tired yet. — M.

versions.title: Waterfront: let's keep listening
versions.body: There are strong feelings on all sides about the Waterfront. I think we owe it to each other to keep listening. Change can be scary, but it can also be good.

Plot 12 finally has tomatoes. The sign Priya painted is crooked and perfect. — M.
[Photo: raised beds, a hand-painted PLOT 12 sign]
